request.style: English, deep soul, impassioned male vocal with backing choir, Hammond organ, electric guitar, bass, drums, swelling strings, from storm to calm, 82 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He sent us out across the sea and climbed the hill to pray
The night came down around us and the land was far away
The wind was hard against us and the waves were breaking high
We were straining at the oars beneath a black and starless sky

[Verse]
In the fourth watch of the night he came walking on the sea
It's a ghost, we cried in terror, there was nowhere we could flee
But his voice came through the thunder like a light across the deep
Take heart, it is I, do not be afraid

[Chorus]
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid
When the wind is high and the water is wide
Take heart, it is I

[Verse]
Peter said, Lord, if it's you, then tell me, come to you
He stepped out on the water and he walked a step or two
But he saw how strong the wind was and he started going down
Lord, save me, cried the fisherman, I'm going to drown

[Chorus]
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid
When the wind is high and the water is wide
Take heart, it is I

[Bridge]
At once he reached his hand out and caught hold of him
Why did you doubt, why did you doubt
They climbed into the boat and the wind died down
Truly you are the Son of God

[Outro]
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid
